answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock collateral in a slashable bond before it can post or vote, and one bond buys exactly one voice. A forger who wants N fake identities must post N independent bonds; caught equivocating, every bond is slashed. Filling a garden of sable puppets therefore costs real capital, and the slashed stake is burned, so each echo of a false vote drains the attacker's own purse.
